verses.en: The righteous perisheth, and no man layeth it to heart: and merciful men are taken away, none considering that the righteous is taken away from the evil to come.
verses.pt: Perece o justo, e não há quem se importe com isso; os homens compassivos são arrebatados, e não há ninguém que entenda. Pois o justo é arrebatado da calamidade,
verses.en_web: The righteous perish, and no one lays it to heart. Merciful men are taken away, and no one considers that the righteous is taken away from the evil.
verses.en_bbe: The upright man goes to his death, and no one gives a thought to it; and god-fearing men are taken away, and no one is troubled by it; for the upright man is taken away because of evil-doing, and goes into peace.

verses.en: He shall enter into peace: they shall rest in their beds, each one walking in his uprightness.
verses.pt: entra em paz; descansam nas suas camas todos os que andam na retidão.
verses.en_web: He enters into peace. They rest in their beds, each one who walks in his uprightness.
verses.en_bbe: They are at rest in their last resting-places, every one going straight before him.

verses.en: But draw near hither, ye sons of the sorceress, the seed of the adulterer and the whore.
verses.pt: Mas chegai-vos aqui, vós os filhos da agoureira, linhagem do adúltero e da prostituta.
verses.en_web: “But draw near here, you sons of a sorceress, you offspring of adulterers and prostitutes.
verses.en_bbe: But come near, you sons of her who is wise in secret arts, the seed of her who is false to her husband, and of the loose woman.

verses.en: Against whom do ye sport yourselves? against whom make ye a wide mouth, and draw out the tongue? are ye not children of transgression, a seed of falsehood,
verses.pt: De quem fazeis escárnio? Contra quem escancarais a boca, e deitais para fora a língua? Porventura não sois vós filhos da transgressão, estirpe da falsidade,
verses.en_web: Whom do you mock? Against whom do you make a wide mouth, and stick out your tongue? Aren’t you children of disobedience, and offspring of falsehood,
verses.en_bbe: Of whom do you make sport? against whom is your mouth open wide and your tongue put out? are you not uncontrolled children, a false seed,

verses.en: Enflaming yourselves with idols under every green tree, slaying the children in the valleys under the clifts of the rocks?
verses.pt: que vos inflamais junto aos terebintos, debaixo de toda árvore verde, e sacrificais os filhos nos vales, debaixo das fendas dos penhascos?
verses.en_web: you who inflame yourselves among the oaks, under every green tree; who kill the children in the valleys, under the clefts of the rocks?
verses.en_bbe: You who are burning with evil desire among the oaks, under every green tree; putting children to death in the valleys, under the cracks of the rocks?

verses.en: Among the smooth stones of the stream is thy portion; they, they are thy lot: even to them hast thou poured a drink offering, thou hast offered a meat offering. Should I receive comfort in these?
verses.pt: Por entre as pedras lisas do vale está o teu quinhão; estas, estas são a tua sorte; também a estas derramaste a tua libação e lhes ofereceste uma oblação. Contentar-me-ia com estas coisas?
verses.en_web: Among the smooth stones of the valley is your portion; they, they are your lot. You have even poured a drink offering to them. You have offered an offering. Shall I be appeased for these things?
verses.en_bbe: Among the smooth stones of the valley is your heritage; they, even they, are your part: even to them have you made a drink offering and a meal offering. Is it possible for such things to be overlooked by me?

verses.en: Upon a lofty and high mountain hast thou set thy bed: even thither wentest thou up to offer sacrifice.
verses.pt: sobre um monte alto e levantado puseste a tua cama; e lá subiste para oferecer sacrifícios.
verses.en_web: On a high and lofty mountain you have set your bed. You also went up there to offer sacrifice.
verses.en_bbe: You have put your bed on a high mountain: there you went up to make your offering.

verses.en: Behind the doors also and the posts hast thou set up thy remembrance: for thou hast discovered thyself to another than me, and art gone up; thou hast enlarged thy bed, and made thee a covenant with them; thou lovedst their bed where thou sawest it.
verses.pt: Detrás das portas e dos umbrais colocaste o teu memorial; pois te descobriste a outro que não a mim, e subiste, e alargaste a tua cama; e fizeste para ti um pacto com eles; amaste a sua cama, onde quer que a viste.
verses.en_web: You have set up your memorial behind the doors and the posts; for you have exposed yourself to someone besides me, and have gone up; you have enlarged your bed, and made you a covenant with them. You loved what you saw on their bed.
verses.en_bbe: And on the back of the doors and on the pillars you have put your sign: for you have been false to me with another; you have made your bed wide, and made an agreement with them; you had a desire for their bed where you saw it

verses.en: And thou wentest to the king with ointment, and didst increase thy perfumes, and didst send thy messengers far off, and didst debase thyself even unto hell.
verses.pt: E foste ao rei com óleo, e multiplicaste os teus perfumes, e enviaste os teus embaixadores para longe, e te abateste até o Seol.
verses.en_web: You went to the king with oil, and increased your perfumes, and sent your ambassadors far off, and degraded yourself even to Sheol.
verses.en_bbe: And you went to Melech with oil and much perfume, and you sent your representatives far off, and went as low as the underworld.

verses.en: Thou art wearied in the greatness of thy way; yet saidst thou not, There is no hope: thou hast found the life of thine hand; therefore thou wast not grieved.
verses.pt: Na tua comprida viagem te cansaste; contudo não disseste: Não há esperança; achaste com que renovar as tuas forças; por isso não enfraqueceste.
verses.en_web: You were wearied with the length of your ways; yet you didn’t say, ‘It is in vain.’ You found a reviving of your strength; therefore you weren’t faint.
verses.en_bbe: You were tired with your long journeys; but you did not say, There is no hope: you got new strength, and so you were not feeble.

verses.en: And of whom hast thou been afraid or feared, that thou hast lied, and hast not remembered me, nor laid it to thy heart? have not I held my peace even of old, and thou fearest me not?
verses.pt: Mas de quem tiveste receio ou medo, para que mentisses, e não te lembrasses de mim, nem te importasses? Não é porventura porque eu me calei, e isso há muito tempo, e não me temes?
verses.en_web: “Whom have you dreaded and feared, so that you lie, and have not remembered me, nor laid it to your heart? Haven’t I held my peace for a long time, and you don’t fear me?
verses.en_bbe: And of whom were you in fear, so that you were false, and did not keep me in mind, or give thought to it? Have I not been quiet, keeping myself secret, and so you were not in fear of me?

verses.en: I will declare thy righteousness, and thy works; for they shall not profit thee.
verses.pt: Eu publicarei essa justiça tua; e quanto às tuas obras, elas não te aproveitarão.
verses.en_web: I will declare your righteousness; and as for your works, they will not benefit you.
verses.en_bbe: I will make clear what your righteousness is like and your works; you will have no profit in them.

verses.en: When thou criest, let thy companies deliver thee; but the wind shall carry them all away; vanity shall take them: but he that putteth his trust in me shall possess the land, and shall inherit my holy mountain;
verses.pt: Quando clamares, livrem-te os ídolos que ajuntaste; mas o vento a todos levará, e um assopro os arrebatará; mas o que confia em mim possuirá a terra, e herdarão o meu santo monte.
verses.en_web: When you cry, let those whom you have gathered deliver you; but the wind will take them. a breath will carry them all away: but he who takes refuge in me will possess the land, and will inherit my holy mountain.”
verses.en_bbe: Your false gods will not keep you safe in answer to your cry; but the wind will take them, they will be gone like a breath: but he who puts his hope in me will take the land, and will have my holy mountain as his heritage.

verses.en: And shall say, Cast ye up, cast ye up, prepare the way, take up the stumblingblock out of the way of my people.
verses.pt: E dir-se-á: Aplanai, aplanai, preparai e caminho, tirai os tropeços do caminho do meu povo.
verses.en_web: He will say, “Build up, build up, prepare the way! Remove the stumbling-block out of the way of my people.”
verses.en_bbe: And I will say, Make it high, make it high, get ready the way, take the stones out of the way of my people.

verses.en: For thus saith the high and lofty One that inhabiteth eternity, whose name is Holy; I dwell in the high and holy place, with him also that is of a contrite and humble spirit, to revive the spirit of the humble, and to revive the heart of the contrite ones.
verses.pt: Porque assim diz o Alto e o Excelso, que habita na eternidade e cujo nome é santo: Num alto e santo lugar habito, e também com o contrito e humilde de espírito, para vivificar o espírito dos humildes, e para vivificar o coração dos contritos.
verses.en_web: For thus says the high and lofty One who inhabits eternity, whose name is Holy: “I dwell in the high and holy place, with him also who is of a contrite and humble spirit, to revive the spirit of the humble, and to revive the heart of the contrite.
verses.en_bbe: For this is the word of him who is high and lifted up, whose resting-place is eternal, whose name is Holy: my resting-place is in the high and holy place, and with him who is crushed and poor in spirit, to give life to the spirit of the poor, and to make strong the heart of the crushed.

verses.en: For I will not contend for ever, neither will I be always wroth: for the spirit should fail before me, and the souls which I have made.
verses.pt: Pois eu não contenderei para sempre, nem continuamente ficarei irado; porque de mim procede o espírito, bem como o fôlego da vida que eu criei.
verses.en_web: For I will not contend forever, neither will I be always angry; for the spirit would faint before me, and the souls whom I have made.
verses.en_bbe: For I will not give punishment for ever, or be angry without end: for from me breath goes out; and I it was who made the souls.

verses.en: For the iniquity of his covetousness was I wroth, and smote him: I hid me, and was wroth, and he went on frowardly in the way of his heart.
verses.pt: Por causa da iniqüidade da sua avareza me indignei e o feri; escondi-me, e indignei-me; mas, rebelando-se, ele seguiu o caminho do seu coração.
verses.en_web: I was angry because of the iniquity of his covetousness, and struck him; I hid myself and was angry; and he went on backsliding in the way of his heart.
verses.en_bbe: I was quickly angry with his evil ways, and sent punishment on him, veiling my face in wrath: and he went on, turning his heart from me.

verses.en: I have seen his ways, and will heal him: I will lead him also, and restore comforts unto him and to his mourners.
verses.pt: Tenho visto os seus caminhos, mas eu o sararei; também o guiarei, e tornarei a dar-lhe consolação, a ele e aos que o pranteiam.
verses.en_web: I have seen his ways, and will heal him: I will lead him also, and restore comforts to him and to his mourners.
verses.en_bbe: I have seen his ways, and I will make him well: I will give him rest, comforting him and his people who are sad.

verses.en: I create the fruit of the lips; Peace, peace to him that is far off, and to him that is near, saith the LORD; and I will heal him.
verses.pt: Eu crio o fruto dos lábios; paz, paz, para o que está longe, e para o que está perto diz o Senhor; e eu o sararei.
verses.en_web: I create the fruit of the lips: Peace, peace, to him who is far off and to him who is near,” says Yahweh; “and I will heal them.”
verses.en_bbe: I will give the fruit of the lips: Peace, peace, to him who is near and to him who is far off, says the Lord; and I will make him well.

verses.en: But the wicked are like the troubled sea, when it cannot rest, whose waters cast up mire and dirt.
verses.pt: Mas os ímpios são como o mar agitado; pois não pode estar quieto, e as suas águas lançam de si lama e lodo.
verses.en_web: But the wicked are like the troubled sea; for it can’t rest, and its waters cast up mire and mud.
verses.en_bbe: But the evil-doers are like the troubled sea, for which there is no rest, and its waters send up earth and waste.

verses.en: There is no peace, saith my God, to the wicked.
verses.pt: Não há paz para os ímpios, diz o meu Deus.
verses.en_web: “There is no peace”, says my God, “for the wicked.”
verses.en_bbe: There is no peace, says my God, for the evil-doers.
